content:
Apple is expanding the availability of watchOS 27.0.1 to more Apple Watch models this week, following last week's initial rollout for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Here's what's new.

Apple Watch users can now install watchOS 27.0.1

Last week, Apple released watchOS 27.0.1 only for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, fixing an issue that could cause some devices to unexpectedly restart.

Apple is now pushing watchOS 27.0.1 to all other Apple Watch models capable of running watchOS 27, including:

  • Apple Watch SE 3
  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3

Apple has not changed the release notes for watchOS 27.0.1, which still read as follows:

In addition, this update carries the same build number, 24R365, as last week's release for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Alongside watchOS 27.0.1, Apple today also released iOS 27.0.1, iPadOS 27.0.1, visionOS 27.0.1, iOS 26.7.1, macOS 27.0.1 Golden Gate, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1.

iOS 27.0.1 addresses an issue where some iPhone 18 Pro models could restart when using Face ID; the other updates include additional bug fixes and security improvements.
